about_the_game:
The WWE 2K25 Season Pass includes 5 post-launch DLC Character Packs, as well as the WWE 2K25 SuperCharger to expand your WWE Universe.

Full DLC Character Pack details will be revealed at a later date.

The Season Pass is included in WWE 2K25 Deadman Edition and as a part of the Ringside Pass (included in The Bloodline Edition).
